Flame Type.reason: Qualitative flame category ('Normal'); no physical measurement unit

Day.reason: Day sequence number without physical measurement unit

Cool flame?.reason: Qualitative observation flag ('Yes', 'No', 'no, PCI-hot'); no physical measurement unit

XO2 before test.reason: Names initial oxygen mole fraction (standard chemical notation X denotes mole fraction). Note: ambient chamber oxygen, distinct from burner-flow O2 (up to 85%) and cabin O2 per Rule R3

XO2 after test.reason: Names final oxygen mole fraction (standard chemical notation X denotes mole fraction)

approx p (bar).reason: Unambiguously names pressure and bar unit (convertible to psi via 1 bar = 14.50377 psi)

Xf.reason: Header 'Xf' lacks explicit unit specification in column title

mHC (mg/s).reason: Unambiguously names hydrocarbon mass flow rate and mg/s unit

TFP.reason: Acronym without unit or unambiguous physical quantity definition

Tad (K).reason: Unambiguously names adiabatic flame temperature and Kelvin unit

Zst.reason: Stoichiometric mixture fraction (dimensionless); lacks unit specification in header

Hot ignition.reason: Qualitative observation flag ('Yes', 'No'); no physical measurement unit

burn time (sec).reason: Unambiguously names burn duration and second unit

Self-ext or flow term.reason: Qualitative extinction mechanism code ('SE', 'FT'); no physical measurement unit

Peak burner T (C ).reason: Unambiguously names burner temperature and Celsius unit

Comments.reason: Free-text operator remarks; no physical measurement unit
